lines: There principal venerable Khecarī, deity-natured, known in undivided state; in divided state Triśūlinī.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra pradhānabhūtā śrīkhecarī devatātmikā niṣkalatvena vikhyātā sākalyena triśūlinī
